visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor sports facility featuring green badminton courts and white lines, a group of five young adults is gathered. A man wearing a white t-shirt and light-colored shorts points emphatically towards a large promotional banner on the wall while gesturing with a yellow baton. Next to him, a woman in a grey athletic shirt holds a blue badminton racket, her expression curious and engaged as she watches the man's movements. (2) The group moves into a tighter circle on the court to begin a selection game. Two more women join, one in a black t-shirt and another in a light grey shirt, all holding rackets. They extend their hands toward the center, performing a rhythmic physical selection game where hands are flipped over. The camera moves dynamically between their hands and their laughing, animated faces, capturing the energetic micro-actions of the group. (3) The scene transitions through several close-up shots of the participants interacting. The man in white and the woman in grey sportswear engage in an animated discussion, pointing at each other and the others with their hands. Another woman with short dark hair, wearing a black top, holds her racket up to her face while speaking passionately and laughing. The studio lighting is bright and even, highlighting their energetic facial expressions and physical postures. (4) As the interaction intensifies, the man in white gestures widely with his arms, his mouth open in an exaggerated expression of surprise or frustration. The background shows a black curtain and various pieces of sports equipment like bags and fans. The camera captures these micro-expressions in quick succession, emphasizing the dynamic physical tension between the friends as they react to each other's gestures and movements. (5) In the concluding sequence, the group continues their animated interaction before the man in white turns away in a comical show of resignation. The others remain on the court, their bodies still in motion as they continue to talk. The scene eventually cuts to a solid grey frame with dark graphical overlays appearing in the center, marking the conclusion of the visible action.
